title: التغافل — الفطن المتغافل
format: 1080x1920, 60 fps; speaker frames are the 30 fps source frames, each shown twice
voice: the speaker's own recording only (no synthesis, no cloning); edited in pauses, see timeline.json and audio/cuts.md

scenes.visual: Cold open, from frame 0: the speaker, title «من أذكى الناس؟»; on «الفطن» the title becomes his answer in green. Source 22.25–27.95 (the exchange is heard once: it is not repeated later).

Definition (lens + notes): an eye draws on; four notes appear around it, each on a dotted line of sight. «تكلّف الغفلة»: a card with a sleepy eye is held up in front of it; behind it the notes still get a tick on «تغافل، تغابى، تكلّف، الغباء». «تظهر كذلك» is written on the card; on «وأنت لست كذلك» the card comes down and the open eye is there, with a green check and «ولست كذلك».
«وهذا التغافل صفة محمودة في الرجال» — title «صفة محمودة».

Notes passing (ملاحظات تمرّ): title «الفطن المتغافل» recalls who «هو» is. Notes keep arriving from the right and pass under the eye; each is seen (line of sight, tick) and none is stopped. «فطِن» (blue) on «فطن», «متغافل» (green) and a half-lowered lid on «متغافل». A magnifier comes down over the lane on «يحقّق» and is crossed out on «في كل».
The opposite, acted out by him: «أنت لماذا قلت؟…» (title in red), then «لذا قال الأول».

Verse 1 as the title, word by word on his voice (captions hidden). Balance (ميزان): right pan «الغبي» (a shut eye), left pan «المتغابي» (half-lidded eye). The crown goes over the first and is refused (red X), then lands on the second on «المتغابي»; that side goes down and turns green.

Verse 2 as the title (captions hidden). Choice paths (مسارات اختيار): from one start, a red path circles each of three matters and ends in a knot short of the goal; «الحمد» appears; on «إلا من غفل» a green path passes the same matters by (they fade) and reaches «الحمد», which pulses on «نعم» and on the repeated «بالحمد».
onScreen: لم يفُزْ بالحمدِ إلا من غفل

scenes.visual: «حمد الرجال، حمد من عاشره… هذه من خصال السادة، من خصال الوجهاء» — titles «حمد من عاشره», then «من خصال السادة» (green).
«هذا التغافل… حتى في بيتك»: the half-lidded eye goes up under a roof, a house is drawn around it, and three rooms light on «بنيك», «أهلك», «من إليك».
Conclusion in his words: «لقد رأيت… لكن», then «اصنع كأنك لم تسمع» (green).
End card after his last word: the half-lidded eye, «الفطن المتغافل», «كتاب وبس», and the source as far as it can be stated: «مقطع منشور على X».
